description: Does this counterparty exist, who runs it, is it active: legal entity from GLEIF (LEI, status, direct and ultimate parent, subsidiaries), UK Companies House (status, incorporation date, officers, persons with significant control, charges, insolvency, overdue filings; needs the free Companies House key in settings), US SEC EDGAR (CIK, SIC, state, tickers, former names, recent filings), plus the sanctions / export-control lists and enforcement history Prax already screens. Returns allow / review / block with entity_status (active, inactive, not_found, listed) and reasons. Use for KYB, vendor and partner onboarding, invoice and payee verification.

jurisdiction.description: GB or US to limit registry lookups (default: both)

number.description: Company registration number (UK Companies House), if known

name: screen_company
title: Company / counterparty check
